text:
jane.pwc (auditor): Hi team — PwC requested additional evidence for KMS/HSM controls and audit log retention for the SOC 2 review. Specifically: key rotation history for the last 12 months, HSM vendor attestation (if any), CloudTrail + access logs covering the last 6 months, and evidence of redaction processes. Can you confirm timeline and provide links?

maria-scc: Thanks Jane. Assigning owners — Kevin for KMS rotation + HSM attestation, Ryan for CloudTrail/export, Sasha for redaction/process docs. We should avoid attaching raw PII.

kevin-sec: I can pull the KMS key rotation schedule and the key policy audit. We use AWS KMS for customer key wrapping; we also have an on-prem HSM for signing in Private installs (Thales). HSM attestation: we have the vendor-signed cert from 2024-05 stored in Vault. I will generate an evidence pack. ETA: EOD today. :white_check_mark:

ryan-engr: I'll export CloudTrail events for the last 6 months scoped to the Redwood account and filter for KMS, IAM, and S3 data events. Will store the export in a secure S3 evidence bucket (s3://redwood-evidence/soc2/1748201123/). Will also include a query result for anomalous egress events.

sasha-support: I'll prepare the redaction SOP and a sample redacted log. We need to confirm which fields are considered PII for the auditor before sharing examples. We have a runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/soc2-redaction — I'll include it.

kevin-sec: For rotation history, here's the quick command I use to list KMS key rotations and key metadata (AWS CLI):

```bash
aws kms list-keys --profile prod-account \
  | jq -r '.Keys[].KeyId' \
  | xargs -n1 -I{} aws kms get-key-rotation-status --key-id {} --profile prod-account
```

I'll attach: key ARN list, rotation enabled flags, and the CloudTrail events showing ScheduleKeyRotation/RotateKey if present.

jane.pwc (auditor): That sounds good. For HSM attestation we only need the vendor certificate + any FIPS/FedRAMP documentation you have. For logs, we need proof that logs are immutable/retained for at least 6 months and that access is logged and restricted.

maria-scc: Note on immutability: CloudTrail to S3 is configured with bucket lock via object lock governance and lifecycle set. Ryan please include the Object Lock configuration export and bucket policy.

ryan-engr: Will do. Quick snippet to export bucket lock config: 

```bash
aws s3api get-object-lock-configuration --bucket redwood-cloudtrail-evidence --profile prod-account
aws s3api get-bucket-policy --bucket redwood-cloudtrail-evidence --profile prod-account
```

kevin-sec: For the on-prem HSM: I will pull the vendor attestation PDF and a signed statement that we control HSM access via our PAM system. Also including access control logs from HSM appliance for the relevant period. Note: those appliance logs contain admin usernames — will be redacted.

sasha-support: For redaction, I'll create two artifacts: (1) redaction procedure doc (SOP) and (2) a sample redacted CloudTrail JSON where IPs and user names are masked. We'll include the masking regex we use.

maria-scc: Ownership + timeline: Kevin (KMS/HSM attestation + rotation) — EOD. Ryan (CloudTrail exports + S3 configs) — 3pm PT. Sasha (redaction docs + sample) — 4pm PT. I'll compile and upload to the auditor share.

audIT-bot: New evidence bundle created: s3://redwood-evidence/soc2/1748201123/pending/ (access limited to auditors@pwc and eng-security).

kevin-sec: Uploaded KMS_rotation_history.csv and HSM_attestation_2024-05.pdf to the evidence bucket. Files: 
- s3://redwood-evidence/soc2/1748201123/KMS_rotation_history.csv
- s3://redwood-evidence/soc2/1748201123/HSM_attestation_2024-05.pdf

ryan-engr: CloudTrail export complete and put at: 
- s3://redwood-evidence/soc2/1748201123/cloudtrail_export_6mo.json.gz
- s3://redwood-evidence/soc2/1748201123/bucket_lock_config.json
Included a CSV of IAM access attempts and a short query for suspicious egress.

sasha-support: Redaction SOP and sample redacted logs uploaded: 
- s3://redwood-evidence/soc2/1748201123/redaction_sop.md
- s3://redwood-evidence/soc2/1748201123/cloudtrail_sample_redacted.json

jane.pwc (auditor): Thanks — quick follow-ups from reviewer: (1) Can you provide proof that the KMS keys are used only for envelope encryption and not for customer plaintext storage? (2) Need the key policy showing which principals can call Decrypt. (3) For the HSM, please provide the chain of custody for the attestation document.

kevin-sec: Replying inline: (1) We have code references showing usage — adding a short snippet from our ingestion service that performs envelope encryption with KMS. (2) Key policy exported and included as KMS_key_policy.json. (3) Chain of custody: uploaded HSM_attestation_chain_of_custody.pdf (shows who received and where stored).

maria-scc: Kevin — please ensure any code snippets do not include secrets/keys. Use example ARNs. Ryan — ensure CloudTrail export shows the Decrypt API usage and map that to IAM principals (we'll redact email addresses).

ryan-engr: I ran a grep for Decrypt events and included a summary: Decrypt event count by principal in Decrypt_summary.csv. I also included the raw events in a redacted form.

jane.pwc (auditor): Good. Last ask: can you provide timestamps for when the key rotation policy was changed (if any) and evidence of scheduled rotation runs? Also, do you have proof that object lock prevents deletion for the retention window?

kevin-sec: Key rotation policy change: we changed rotation_enabled flag on two keys on 2024-11-02. I attached CloudTrail entries showing the update event. Scheduled rotations are automated monthly for those keys — evidence in KMS_rotation_history.csv shows rotation timestamps.

ryan-engr: Object lock: I exported the bucket's object lock config and also included a short test artifact with retention set to 90 days that shows a failed delete attempt (403) when attempted by a non-privileged principal. See test_delete_attempt_403.log.

maria-scc: Great. Next steps: I will redact final exports, bundle into a zip, and share a pre-signed auditor link with expiry 7 days. Jane: will that work?

jane.pwc (auditor): Yes — presigned link with 7-day expiry is fine. Also please include a short CSV mapping artifacts -> control IDs (e.g., CC6, CC7).

maria-scc: Adding artifact-to-control mapping now and will post link once prepared. ETA 6pm PT.

kevin-sec: Quick note for the record: all evidence generation steps are logged in the SOC2 evidence tracker (https://redwood.internal/soc2/tracker) with task IDs.

sasha-support: Thanks everyone — I'll be on call if the auditor asks for clarifications. :+1:

jane.pwc (auditor): Received the link and confirmed download access. Reviewing now, will follow up with final Qs by tomorrow morning. Thank you all.

maria-scc: Thank you team. Closing the thread once auditor signs off. :tada:
